section.32: Dialects and Readings of the Qur'an (Kitab Al-Huruf Wa Al-Qira'at)

32.name_native: Dialects and Readings of the Qur'an (Kitab Al-Huruf Wa Al-Qira'at)

hadiths.text: Narrated Aisha, Ummul Mu'minin: I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) read: "(There is for him) Rest and satisfaction" (faruhun wa rayhan)
